title: Strong-disorder expansion of the root-averaged density of states for the Anderson model on the Bethe lattice
summary: We study the root-averaged density of states for the Anderson model on the Bethe lattice in the strong-disorder regime. Here the density of states means the root-averaged spectral measure, not a finite-volume eigenvalue counting limit. We assume that the single-site distribution has compact support and has a locally analytic density on an interval $I^\sharp$ containing a given interval $I$.
